title: NEAR Smart Contracts
description: Set up the toolchain, write and test a contract, use storage collections and promises, understand access keys, and deploy to testnet.
prerequisites: Web3 Fundamentals, especially accounts, gas, and what a smart contract is.
Comfortable reading a little Rust or JavaScript. You can follow the Rust examples even if you write JS contracts later.
youWillBuild: A small greeting (or similar) contract you test locally, then deploy to a faucet-funded testnet account and call with near-cli-rs.
overview: This is the core contract-development course. You install cargo-near and near-cli-rs, write and unit-test a near-sdk contract, store data in near_sdk::store collections, make asynchronous cross-contract calls with promises and callbacks, issue function-call keys safely, and deploy to NEAR testnet.
